title: Morning at Home and Packing the Lamp
summary: You eat oatmeal with banana and tea while reviewing a lamp wiring sketch, then wrap the broken desk lamp in a towel and pack it with a screwdriver set. You grab an umbrella and jacket, notice something metallic by the door, pat your pockets, and leave.

title: Tram to Fernhollow
summary: You walk to the tram stop with an umbrella, then ride line 4 toward Fernhollow, checking the stop name and mumbling about getting off at Fernhollow.

title: Check-In at Fernhollow Repair Cafe
summary: At the repair cafe, a volunteer greets you and takes an intake form for the desk lamp, noting the flickering and cracked rocker switch.

title: Opening the Lamp and Checking the Switch
summary: At the workbench, you and the volunteer open the lamp base and inspect the wiring; the volunteer finds the rocker switch cracked inside and arcing, and gets a multimeter to test the cord.

title: Testing the Cord and Strain Relief
summary: The volunteer teaches you to test the cord for continuity; the meter beeps and the cord is good. You discuss strain relief and the knot inside the base.

title: Coffee Break and Chat
summary: During a coffee break, you and the volunteer chat about the repair cafe's Saturday schedule, a spare-parts bin, and a toaster someone brought; you pause recording around midday for a break, returning at one.

title: Searching the Spare-Parts Bin
summary: After the break, the volunteer searches the spare-parts bin for a matching rocker switch, but none fits the lamp's cutout.

title: Ordering a Replacement Switch
summary: The volunteer decides to order a replacement switch, expected Tuesday, and will text the tracking number; you agree to leave the lamp at the cafe until then.

title: Re-Seating the Cord and Tying a Knot
summary: Quiet focused work: you re-seat the cord, tie a strain-relief knot inside the base, and tidy the wires, keeping the four base screws in a small dish.

title: Storing Screws and Shelving the Lamp
summary: You put the four screws on the lid of a red toolbox for safekeeping; the volunteer confirms the toolbox stays on the bench. The lamp goes on the waiting-for-parts shelf with a blue tag until Tuesday, and you say goodbye.

title: Bakery Stop for Bread and Cinnamon Buns
summary: Walking to the bakery in light drizzle, the cashier recommends the warm cinnamon buns. You buy a rye loaf and two cinnamon buns and lean the umbrella against the counter.

title: Library Visit and Repair Manual Hold
summary: At the library holds desk, staff says the lamp repair manual will be ready Tuesday afternoon and renews your card. In the reading room, you browse a small appliance repair book.

title: Evening Tram Home
summary: You ride line 4 home in evening rain, muttering a reminder to pick up the switch at the repair cafe and the manual at the library on Tuesday afternoon.

title: Dinner, Voice Note, and Evening Notes
summary: You return home, lean the wet umbrella by the door, and have soup with rye bread and a cinnamon bun. You record a voice note for Tuesday and later mumble about not seeing something by the door that morning.
